messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT - europe-west3 GPU pool healthy threshold breached. autoscaler failed to acquire GPUs; queue growth detected (inference-queue length ~48k). Possible quota/limit hit reported by allocation API. Auto-retries ongoing.

erin_sre: seeing 503s on /v1/generate for some customers, spike at 10:13 UTC. Queue tail latency >> SLO. Can oncall try manual scale first?

sam_platform: trying manual scale now, but the API returns `RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: Quota exceeded for region europe-west3` when provisioning N1 GPUs.

miguel_cloudops: I'm on it — checking GCP quotas and organization-level quota locks. Suspect we hit per-project GPU limit (acceleratorQuota) and preemptible pool is saturated. Opening console now.

anya_prod: customer impact: several mid-MRR customers reported timeouts. Ticket #CS-8892 is getting noisy. We should post a status update ASAP.

noah_support: I'm drafting a short incident note: "We are investigating increased errors and latency in Europe; mitigation in progress." Will wait for confirmable mitigation steps.

miguel_cloudops: confirmed: `acceleratorQuota` for GPUs in project redwood-main-eu is at limit; there's also an organization policy that prevents borrowing from sibling billing projects. Opening a support case with GCP support (case 123456789) and requesting emergency quota increase. Also seeing quota burst requests rejected due to billing threshold.

erin_sre: mitigation plan proposals: 1) route new inference requests to eu-west1 fallback pool (smaller models) 2) temporarily enable CPU-only fallback fleet for low-priority jobs 3) pause large batch/async job ingestion 4) request immediate quota bump + failover to another region if needed. Thoughts?

sam_platform: executing (1) and (3) now. Pushed routing rule change to canary route for non-SLO traffic: 
```
# switch route map to fallback for queued requests older than 10s
redwoodctl route update --name europe-gen-fallback --match "queue_age>10" --dest eu-west1-small
```
Applied canary to 10% of traffic.

anya_prod: posting initial status: "We are experiencing degraded inference performance in Europe (short-term timeouts). Engineers are investigating and routing non-critical requests to alternate pools."

noah_support: clients on our enterprise list notified via email channel. Some asked if this is related to recent tenant migrations — it's not.

miguel_cloudops: GCP support replied: quota request is in progress but will take ~45-90 mins. They offered temporary quota from partner pool if we can accept cross-project billing shift — requires approvals.

erin_sre: while we wait for quota, enable CPU fallback for small models and drain long-running async jobs. Sam, can you add a throttle on new batch submissions?

sam_platform: added submission throttle to 5% of prior throughput and paused new scheduled batch jobs. Also bumped KV cache TTL to reduce duplicate recompute.

incident-bot: On-call handoff: @er in 30m. Current severity: Sev2 (degraded service, partial customer impact).

miguel_cloudops: manual provisioning attempt using gcloud fails with same `RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED` (quota). Snippet: 
```
gcloud compute instances create gpu-temp-01 --accelerator type=nvidia-tesla-t4,count=1 --zone europe-west3-b
# Error: Quota 'NVIDIA_TESLA_T4' exceeded for 'project redwood-main-eu' in 'europe-west3'
```

erin_sre: start plan B: can we spin up a dedicated reserved pool in eu-west1 (our reserved contract) and route higher-paying customers there? That pool has capacity.

miguel_cloudops: yes reserved pool eu-west1-dedicated has free slots. Need to map customers and set up routing auth. I'll prepare a mapping and token rotation.

sam_platform: executed route for enterprise customers (10 tenants) to dedicated pool. Early metrics: 10 of 10 now served with normal latency. :thumbsup:

anya_prod: updating status: "Enterprise customers are being routed to a reserved EU pool; retail traffic is on fallback models. Realtime mitigation in progress."

noah_support: collecting impacted customers list and ETA: estimate partial mitigation within 15–30m for most customers; waiting on quota for full normal throughput.

miguel_cloudops: GCP support provided temporary 24-hour quota reallocation for +60 GPUs if we accept partner billing move. Getting legal/billing signoff — @sam_platform please ack if we should accept to restore full capacity quickly.

sam_platform: Ack — accept partner billing reallocation to restore production throughput. Send me the Docusign/approval flow.

erin_sre: once quota is restored we'll gradually remove fallback routing and throttles. Steps after quota: 1) allow autoscaler to reclaim target size 2) resume paused batch jobs via controlled ramp 3) revert canary routing 4) postmortem assignment.

miguel_cloudops: filed infra runbook action: `case 123456789` with GCP and `billing-change-req` created. Also added temporary firewall rule to allow cross-project allocation for GPUs.

incident-bot: Pager update: @er oncall acknowledged. Next handoff at +4h if unresolved.

anya_prod: reminder for comms: prepare a short follow-up status for in 30 minutes and a public update if outage persists >60 minutes.

noah_support: CS notes: collect logs from customers who saw 503s (timestamps, example request IDs) — I'll collate into the support ticket.

sam_platform: observing queue length dropping from 48k -> 11k after routing + throttle. Tail latencies improving for routed tenants.

erin_sre: great. We'll keep this thread for coordination. After full restore we need a post-incident review covering: quota forecasting, autoscaler backoff behavior, and a fallback policy that automates enterprise routing.

miguel_cloudops: update 20m: GCP support confirmed emergency grant applied; autoscaler is starting to provision additional nodes. I see new instances initializing in europe-west3-b.

incident-bot: RESOLVED -> Partial recovery in region europe-west3. Improvements confirmed. Close thread after final verification and schedule a postmortem. :white_check_mark:

erin_sre: closing notes: - Root cause: project-level GPU quota exhausted + org-level policy preventing cross-project borrowing. - Short-term mitigations: emergency quota grant + enterprise routing + CPU fallback + throttle. - Action items: (1) increase baseline quota for redwood-main-eu, (2) implement automated fallback routing when queue_age>threshold, (3) review billing org policies that block emergency borrowing. Owners assigned in postmortem doc.

noah_support: final status posted to customers at 11:05 UTC. Thanks team.

anya_prod: filing postmortem ticket now.
